Samsung plans $9.15 billion semiconductor investment

Samsung affiliates are planning a semiconductor investment totaling $9.15 billion. A significant portion of this investment, nearly $6 billion, is earmarked for expansion in Vietnam. Other major expansions are also planned in South Korea.
